svg.title: Bench wiring: 2016-2017 Tacoma 3.5 L ECM
svg.desc: A spare 2016-2017 Tacoma 3.5 L automatic ECM (89661-04K50..04K54) powered on a desk and read through an OBD-II socket by an OBDLink EX and Icarus. Only confirmed pins are drawn as connections; unverified ones are dashed red CHECK IN TIS boxes.
svg.text: Bench wiring: a spare ECM on a desk, read by an OBDLink EX and Icarus

svg.text: images. Identify every wire by its
color on the pigtail before you trust
Wire with the power off; meter
IGN on, then the output; watch
Folds back? Raise the limit in
Down: IGN off, then the supply.
+12 V live whenever the supply is on (confirmed)
CAN at the socket: pins 6, 14 and R1 (confirmed)
open circle: join only once settled
CHECK IN TIS BEFORE WIRING (not verified)
not wired until TIS or a measurement settles it
A bench supply with a current limit you can set and an isolated output: 13.5 V, the limit
about 2 A to start (my reasoning, not a sourced figure).
Fuses first: F1 and F2 (5 A each) sit right at supply +, before the IGN switch.
Never a truck battery, a jump pack or a supply without a settable limit: they push tens
of amps into a miswired pin.
Power off (IGN off, output off) whenever you wire or rewire.
CAN as a twisted pair. R1 (120 Ω) at the socket always; R2 only when the ECM has
BOOT stays insulated. Never connect the bench to the truck or power it from the truck;
Later flash work: hold 13.5 V, never below 11.8 V or above 16.0 V (T-SB-0134-16).
Every ground pin to supply −: continuity.
The +B / +B2 / IGSW rail to ground: not near 0 Ω.
Socket pins 6 to 14: about 60 Ω (R1 with the ECM's own terminator, or R1 with R2).
Every other cavity and socket pin: leave empty.
Never wire from PCMflash's six-connector pin table or its connector D row 3 and 4
numbers, any 2.7 L (2TR-FE) pinout, PCMflash's two-connector or 2GR-FXS/8GR-FXS
layouts, or the Lexus IS pins.
6-speed manual (04K60-04K64) and 2018+ ECMs: their pins weren't compared with this
ECM's (for 2018+, only MREL was), so this drawing isn't verified for them.
Nothing answers? EX LED green, about 60 Ω across 6 and 14, the grounds, the CAN
pins against TIS. Never tie BOOT to make it answer.
